activationDenied.note: The suffix is the first blocking code from partner_activation_checklist.missing. Read the full checklist to render every remaining step; do not parse only the suffix. review_partner_application swallows this error so the staff approval still commits — the partner stays PENDING and activation_block_codes carries the codes.

rc5Notes.VALIDATION_FAILED: submit_partner_application raises this for an unknown p_partner_type, a missing legal name or contact email, a KvK supplied by an INDIVIDUAL, or a BUSINESS without a company name or without an 8-digit KvK.
rc5Notes.FORBIDDEN: All admin_get_* RPCs and partner_try_activate require staff. activate_partner_profile and reactivate_partner require OWNER/ADMIN. A partner can never activate itself.
rc5Notes.FEATURE_DISABLED: add_portal_support_internal_note requires support_internal_notes_rpc; staff_set_partner_compliance_fixture requires partner_compliance_fixtures.
rc5Notes.AAL2_REQUIRED: activate_partner_profile and reactivate_partner require an aal2 session.
